description: Backstop deny-list: endpoints that let a credentialed tab mint or register its own durable credential (or move work outside the tab with its own credential), after which it no longer needs the broker. Applied to any request the broker would inject a credential into. Bindings remain allowlist-first; this is defence in depth. Paths are matched case-insensitively against the canonical path with any trailing slash removed.

source.note: operationId and docs URL per entry come from that pinned OpenAPI description unless marked otherwise.

exceptions.reason: Copilot runtime's and agent host's first call (secure-agentic spike, 2026-11-05; measured in a tab behind its broker, B2 run at secure-agentic c759e5c): read-only user info, not a mint. Coordinator-approved 2026-11-05 with conditions: exact path, case-sensitive; no body, no query, no upgrade; the response must be a strict JSON object with no credential-named key (bar benignKeys) and no token-shaped value anywhere, else it is blocked and audited as credential.backstop_exception_blocked (a finding). Top-level fields outside responseFields are then dropped and audited as credential.backstop_exception_filtered. responseFields is the union of what the agent host reads (src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/shared/copilotApiService.ts L84-98 @ microsoft/vscode a717861c) and upstream's own stub (test/node/e2e/harness/capiStubs.ts); STUB-DERIVED, the real response is unmeasured (no real credential, by rule). ADR 20261105-broker-model-access.

Org policy the runtime enforces on the agent (measured in the B2 run; denied then, turns completed). Approved by the project owner 2026-11-05: exactly these three GETs, with the same strict checks as /user. The response is the enterprise's .github/copilot/settings.json; responseFields are the top-level keys of IManagedSettingsResponse (src/vs/workbench/services/accounts/browser/managedSettings.ts L40-85 @ microsoft/vscode a717861c) plus its compatibility-error fields (L118-122). strictFields: any other top-level key blocks the response, on every status (secure-agentic review: fail closed until measured). telemetry is dropped whole, whatever its shape (dropFields): its headers map carries an OTLP endpoint's credentials under names the credential-key pattern can't see, and the org's restrictions don't depend on it (review 11b-2). ADR 20261105-broker-model-access.

One of the three org-policy GETs approved by the project owner (2026-11-05). Its response shape is unmeasured and not in public client code, so responseFields lists only GitHub's REST error envelope (message, documentation_url, status) and is strict: only an empty object or that envelope passes; anything else is blocked as a finding until the shape is known.

One of the three org-policy GETs approved by the project owner (2026-11-05): an enterprise's Copilot content exclusions. The runtime's response shape is unmeasured; the Copilot extension parses an array of {rules, last_updated_at} from its own content-exclusion endpoint (extensions/copilot/src/platform/ignore/node/remoteContentExclusion.ts L30-40 @ a717861c), not proven to be this route's shape. So responseFields lists only GitHub's REST error envelope (message, documentation_url, status) and is strict: only an empty object or that envelope passes; anything else (including a top-level array) is blocked as a finding until the shape is measured.

deny.reason: apps/create-from-manifest (returns an app private key and client secret) https://docs.github.com/rest/apps/apps#create-a-github-app-from-a-manifest
apps/check-token, apps/reset-token (reset mints a new token) https://docs.github.com/rest/apps/oauth-applications#reset-a-token
enterprise runner registration token; not in the api.github.com description at the pinned SHA, included as defence in depth for GHEC/GHES
enterprise runner remove token; defence in depth (see above)
enterprise JIT runner config; defence in depth (see above)
legacy OAuth Authorizations API (removed upstream; absent from the pinned description). Denied in case a GHES version still serves it
codespaces/create-for-authenticated-user: a codespace runs outside the tab with its own GitHub token https://docs.github.com/rest/codespaces/codespaces#create-a-codespace-for-the-authenticated-user

undocumented Copilot internal API, including the Copilot session-token endpoint /copilot_internal/v2/token. No first-party public reference; widely observed in third-party Copilot clients. Copilot tokens must be minted by the host, not the tab
